subject: Re: Clearwave security walkthrough — preferred 90min window & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security.ops@clearwave.com, David Li <david.li@clearwave.com>
Date: 2025-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security walkthrough — request for 90-min slot

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick response earlier. We're ready to schedule the SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough plus a short pen-test scope discussion. We'd like a single 90-minute session (preferred) that covers controls map, network topology, and the pen vendor handoff. Our security ops folks (cc'd) need to be present.

Timezone constraints: our primary team is PST; we prefer windows that start no earlier than 10:00 PT and end by 17:00 PT. Can you propose a couple of concrete slots?

Also: we ask that any evidence you plan to show (SOC artifact excerpts, network diagram) be uploaded to the shared Drive folder ahead of time (or sent via your SFTP). Link for uploads in case you need it: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D

Samira
Samira Khan
Senior Security Program Manager
Clearwave Finance

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — request for 90-min slot

Samira — thanks for the details and the upload link.

We can do the 90-minute format. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 2025-11-04 10:30–12:00 PT (morning, our EU SME can join remotely)
- Option B: Wed 2025-11-05 13:00–14:30 PT (late afternoon for you, more overlap for our infra team)
- Option C: Thu 2025-11-06 15:00–16:30 PT (preferred if you need later in the day)

Notes / asks:
- Please upload any exhibits at least 48 hours before (we'll do the same).
- We'll plan the session agenda as: quick intros (10m), controls mapping (25m), network & topology (20m), pen-test scope / vendor questions (25m), Q&A and next steps (10m).
- Can you confirm which internal Clearwave attendees will lead network and pen-vendor questions so we can route slides to the right SME?

I'll loop in Laura and Ben for staffing; Olga will bring the runbook and a boiled-down network diagram. Attaching a placeholder calendar invite and a short RFI we typically run pre-walkthrough.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Solutions Engineer, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (placeholder), SOC2-RFI.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security.ops@clearwave.com, David Li <david.li@clearwave.com>
Date: 2025-10-29T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — request for 90-min slot

Tessa — Option B (Wed 11/05 13:00–14:30 PT) works best for us. David will lead on network questions; security.ops will own pen-vendor coordination. Expect uploads from our side by Monday EOD (we'll put the full vendor list and a short inventory sheet in the Drive folder).

One request: our procurement team requires a brief note of the expected participants from Redwood (names + roles) for their internal approval flow. Can you send over a 1-line list?

Samira

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: staffing for Clearwave walkthrough (11/05)

Tessa — for the 11/05 13:00–14:30 PT window I can take controls mapping and federal/compliance questions. Ben can pick up the pen-test scope and vendor-sourcing line, Olga will present the network diagram. Suggest we have Ben on the call for the last 40 minutes to handle vendor Qs and the follow-up action items.

I'll draft the 1-line participants list for procurement:
- Tessa Morgan — Solutions Engineer (security walkthrough lead)
- Laura Bennett — Product Security Manager (controls & compliance)
- Ben Carter — Security Solutions Architect (pen-test scope)
- Olga Petrov — Infrastructure Engineer (network/topology)

I'll attach the sanitized network image (network-topology.png) to the prep note and upload a tightened version to the Drive.

Laura

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@clearwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-30T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security walkthrough — request for 90-min slot

Samira — confirmed for Wed 2025-11-05 13:00–14:30 PT. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics) and participant list below for procurement:
- Tessa Morgan — Solutions Engineer (security walkthrough lead)
- Laura Bennett — Product Security Manager (controls & compliance)
- Ben Carter — Security Solutions Architect (pen-test scope)

Best,
